title: scene-server: access/cap test gaps, spec decisions
description:
scene-server: test gaps and two spec-reading decisions (batch 8b review, JMAP-0x0q.17/.20/.21/.22/.23/.24).

1. src/interact.rs: the `interactions.len() > max_objects_in_set` requestTooLarge cap (ponytail choice, not in spec) has no test; tests/object_interact.rs never exceeds it. Add a one-entry test with max_objects_in_set=0.
2. src/memory.rs:333-344 Inner::admits: grants access to an avatar only when left_at.is_none() (draft-atwood-jmap-scene-00 L2595 "an active SceneAvatar"), but no test checks that a departed/ejected avatar in an "invite" region loses access (L3602 ejection walkthrough: record is notFound after eject). Removing the condition fails no test.
3. tests/asset_capability.rs:80-85 supported_account_is_not_gated checks only get/set/query; add changes/queryChanges asserting any error is not unknownMethod.
4. tests/avatar_set.rs: SceneBackend::may_enter_region returning false (re-entry branch of update_avatar and the create path -> forbidden, spec L2363) is unreachable with MemoryBackend; no test mentions may_enter_region. Add a wrapper backend that denies it.
5. src/asset.rs:456: update_asset keeps vendor extension properties patchable on purpose. Spec L698 ("All other properties are immutable or server-set") and L844 (changing a property other than name/assetUri/sha256 is invalidProperties) read literally reject them. Record a decision if extras-preservation is meant to win.
6. tests/avatar_set.rs spec_leave_example / spec_eject_example: code echoes `updated: {id: {leftAt: <now>}}` (RFC 8620 §5.3 server-set echo), but the spec examples (after L2318, Step 6 L3296-3310, Step 4 eject L3571-3585) show `updated: {id: null}`. Code is right; file a jmap-chat-spec bead so the examples echo leftAt, and note the conflict in the tests.
